name: US Medical Records
description: US medical records and clinical notes. Detects patient names, dates of birth in every common format, Medical Record Numbers (MRN — 6+ digit runs without decimals), SSN, full US street addresses, ZIP codes, emails and US phone numbers. Preserves lab values by ignoring numbers with commas/periods and short runs (under 5 digits).

patterns.name: MRN
patterns.description: Medical Record Number: 6 or more digits in a row with no digit, period or comma next to them. Lab values like 12.4 or 1,234.56 and short numbers stay visible. 9-digit SSNs written without dashes are covered here too.

patterns.name: ZIP
patterns.description: US ZIP code, 5 digits or ZIP+4.

patterns.name: Date
patterns.description: Full dates in every common format: MM/DD/YYYY or MM-DD-YYYY, 'January 5, 1980' or 'Jan 5 1980', '5 January 1980' and ISO YYYY-MM-DD, years 1900-2099.

patterns.name: Phone
patterns.description: US phone number: (XXX) XXX-XXXX, XXX-XXX-XXXX or XXX.XXX.XXXX, optional +1, not inside longer numbers.
